audit_item: M0.1/A08 / signed native commission rebate metrics
finding: Instrument rules and the native fee model preserve negative maker/taker rates as exchange rebates, and native commission parsing allowed signed amounts, but AccountFactsAccumulator rejected any negative per-period fee. Direct account metrics and both native report paths therefore failed on a valid rebate.
change: Allow signed finite fee rows while retaining nonnegative turnover, positive equity, and the existing slippage policy. Signed fee aggregation and gross-return normalization already use the signed amount, so a rebate remains visible in total_fee and is removed from gross return consistently.
regressions: Added one direct account-facts rebate case and one batch/online Native report parity case using a negative commission. Both tests failed against the previous implementation and pass after the fix.
